usedFor: MyDocSafe handles signatures and forms, and Memory stores a key-value record through “Memory” whenever “Document is Signed” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “Document is Signed” in MyDocSafe, then “Memory” in Memory
bestTemplate.why: A signed document leaves a stored key and value, so later runs can check what has been signed.

watchOut: “Document is Signed” fires only when all required parties have signed, so partial signing never writes to Memory.
